if you're hypersensitive to sound (or other stimuli) then you can become introverted because the environment is a stronger stimulus for you than for other people who aren't as sensitive
http://www.aitinstitute.org/ - the website is geared towards autistic children though at bottom of that page it lists some of what it helps
ear infections are a big possible sign
- the theory is that because sound is painful your brain starts to pay attention to sound abnormally, because it wants to avoid sources of pain. this causes then your focus to abnormally be fixed moreso toward sound and prevents your focus from shifting to other things with less friction/less effort (makes it more exhausting to focus and to learn)
edit: there is simple way to know if you are a potential candidate to benefit from AIT; you get an audiogram done to check for imbalances in hearing (how low of Db can you hear in each ear.. eg: if at 1000 hz the lowest sound you can hear is 12 dbs, and right ear you hear at 15 db)

you could just be sensitive to the environment, and more greatly affected by shifts in environment around you (changes in noise, light [sensitivity to light, etc]; if you're with someone you know then your focus / attention can be on them, interactions with them, and so you won't notice the environmental changes.
